originals.citation: Iannone, P., Czichowsky, C., & Ruf, J. (2020). The impact of high stakes oral performance assessment on students' approaches to learning: a case study. Educational Studies in Mathematics, 103, 313-337.

quote: The methodology we use for the current study is that of a replication study. We employ the research tools of (Iannone et al., 2020) and deploy them in a country with a strong oral assessment culture—the Czech Republic. ... the first author designed the study that is replicated (Iannone et al., 2020)
notes: Iannone & Simpson 2015 (@iannone2014 on the list) is cited as a related earlier intervention, not the replicated study. Co-author names and DOI of the original from memory.
